description_en: Creates a Data Service API by calling CreateDataServiceApi
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-data-service-api --project-id 10000 --api-name Test_API_name --group-id Business_process_ID --api-mode 0 --request-method 0 --response-content-type 0 --timeout 10000 --visible-range 0 --protocols 0,1 --api-path /test/1 --api-description Test_API_description --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDataServiceApi

parameters.help_en: The name of the API. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_), and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. The name must be 4 to 50 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: API的名称，支持汉字、英文、数字和下划线（_），且只能以英文和汉字开头，4~50个字符
parameters.name: api_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the business process
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the API. Valid values: 0 (wizard API), 1 (script API), and 2 (registration API)
parameters.help_zh: API的类型，可选枚举值包括0（向导API）、1（脚本API）和2（注册API）
parameters.name: api_mode

parameters.help_en: The request method of the API. Valid values: 0 (GET), 1 (POST), 2 (PUT), and 3 (DELETE). Wizard and script APIs support GET and POST. Registration APIs support GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE
parameters.help_zh: API的请求方式，可选枚举值包括0（GET）、1（POST）、2（PUT）和3（DELETE）。向导和脚本API支持GET和POST。注册API支持GET、POST、PUT和DELETE
parameters.name: request_method

parameters.help_en: The response data type of the API. Valid values: 0 (JSON) and 1 (XML). Wizard and script APIs support JSON. Registration APIs support JSON and XML
parameters.help_zh: API的返回数据类型，可选枚举值包括0（JSON）和1（XML）。向导和脚本API支持JSON，注册API支持JSON和XML
parameters.name: response_content_type

parameters.help_en: The timeout period, in milliseconds (ms). Valid values: (0, 30000]
parameters.help_zh: 超时时间，单位为毫秒（ms），取值范围为(0, 30000]
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_zh: 可见范围，可选枚举值包括0（工作空间）和1（私有）
parameters.name: visible_range

parameters.help_en: The protocol of the API. Valid values: 0 (HTTP) and 1 (HTTPS). Multiple values are supported. Separate multiple values with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: API的协议，可选枚举值包括0（HTTP）和1（HTTPS）。支持多个值，多个值之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: protocols

parameters.help_en: The details of the wizard API. For more information, see the JSON string of the wizardDetails field in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174013.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 向导API的详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174013.html接口wizardDetails字段的JSON String
parameters.name: wizard_details

parameters.example: {"isPagedResponse":false,"script":"select id as id1, name as name1 from person where id=${inputid}","scriptConnection":{"connectionId":122786,"tableName":"person"},"scriptRequestParameters":[{"defaultValue":"","exampleValue":"","isRequiredParameter":true,"parameterDataType":0,"parameterDescription":"","parameterName":"inputid","parameterOperator":0,"parameterPosition":1}],"scriptResponseParameters":[{"exampleValue":"","parameterDataType":0,"parameterDescription":"","parameterName":"id1"},{"exampleValue":"","parameterDataType":0,"parameterDescription":"","parameterName":"name1"}]}
parameters.help_en: The details of the script API. For more information, see the JSON string of the scriptDetails field in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174013.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 脚本API的详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174013.html接口scriptDetails字段的JSON String
parameters.name: script_details

parameters.help_en: The details of the registration API. For more information, see the JSON string of the registrationDetails field in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174013.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 注册API的详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174013.html接口registrationDetails字段的JSON String
parameters.name: registration_details

parameters.help_en: The path of the API. The path can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and must start with a forward slash (/). The path cannot exceed 200 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: API的路径，支持英文、数字、下划线（_）和连字符（-），且只能以斜线（/）开头，不能超过200个字符
parameters.name: api_path

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination folder in which the API is created. The ID of the root folder under a business process is 0. The ID of a user-created folder is greater than 0
parameters.help_zh: 创建API的目标文件夹ID，业务流程下根文件夹ID等于0，用户自建文件夹ID大于0
parameters.name: folder_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the exclusive resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The request content type. Valid values:

0: XML

1: JSON

2: form
parameters.name: request_content_type

Data.description_en: The ID of the created API

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. A unique identifier for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，一次请求的唯一标识

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
